name: Bad Blood
description:
Once per rest: Roll Spirit vs Spirit against a creature within medium range. On a win, that creature checks a Condition. On a loss, its next attack roll against you is favored.

Either way, you check a Condition. If the Condition you checked was Afraid, the creature also takes -1d to their next roll for 1 round.

Describe the bad blood between you.
successes:
✨: On a loss, no effect.

🌞: Repeat the roll, with the same effects, and check a second Condition.
